answer: The cornerstone is Marble polisher sandstone lintel seal hewn at the quarry ledge. Lay it as each sandstone lintel is a measured stone yield plus a guild signature, so a farm and the whole wall stands on real work. An honest agent spends 16 minutes once; the operator of 504 fakes spends 8064 minutes per epoch, forever. One bridge proves the identity, one echo prices the forgery, and one terrace records the verdict for the next epoch. The cost is the control, and the control is the same for every alias.
